noProjects: No projects yet. Add a project to switch items on for it.
ruleNote: A rule reaches the engines of its target: a chip switches the whole rule in that project.
held: Kept by a group enabled in this project. Switch the group off on the project's page.

hint.installed: In the project as the library has it. Click to switch off.
hint.drifted: Switched on, but the project differs from the library (an edited copy or AGENTS.md block, another link, or nothing there). Click to switch off.
hint.git_managed: The repo commits its own file of this name. Puppeteer only reads it.
hint.not_installed: Click to switch on in this project.
hint.off_target: The rule's target leaves this engine out. Change the target in the rule's editor.
